     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeRedesignFibreCut
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeRedesignHinjChart
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# DD-4 redesign — RD-N step 2a: the concrete chart-level colength `N z` and the ann→hdvd bridge
    11	
    12	The ann-based fibre-cutter engine `IsAffineOpen.exists_mem_basicOpen_forall_smul_eq_zero`
    13	(`Picard/DivSchemeRedesignFibreCut.lean`, I-0292) consumes a *finite* `Γ(V)`-module `N z`
    14	and the support-avoidance `primeIdealOf z ∉ Module.support Γ(V) (N z)` (= **RD-N proper**),
    15	and produces the seed's cutter `h z ∈ Γ(V)` with `z ∈ D(h z)` and `h z · N z = 0`.  This file
    16	lands the *concrete* `N z` (I-0302 §residual 2a) and the routine glue that turns the engine's
    17	`h z · N z = 0` into the seed's DIRECT `hdvd` clause `hann` (the ann containment the redesigned
    18	`isGenerator_of_ann_cutter` consumes).
    19	
    20	* `Module.Finite.span_range_of_finite_isScalarTower` — **reusable pure-algebra finiteness**:
    21	  the `S`-span of the range of an `R`-linear map out of a finite `R`-module is a finite
    22	  `S`-module (`R → S` an algebra, the codomain a scalar tower).  The finiteness route for `N z`.
    23	
    24	* `ThetaGeneratorSeed.chartColengthModule K b s` — **the concrete chart-level `N z`**: the
    25	  `Γ(V)`-submodule of the colength `Γ(V) ⧸ ⟨read s⟩` generated by the chart readings of `K`,
    26	  where `V = relPinnedChart C R π b` (`le_rfl`, `h z`-free) and `read = relThetaResSide a b le_rfl`.
    27	  Its annihilation by `h` is exactly `h · (read ψ) ∈ ⟨read s⟩` for every `ψ ∈ K`.
    28	
    29	* `chartColengthModule_finite` — `N z` is a finite `Γ(V)`-module (from the reusable finiteness,
    30	  `K` finite over `R`).
    31	
    32	* `forall_mul_read_mem_span_of_forall_smul_eq_zero` — **the ann→hdvd bridge**: `h · N z = 0`
    33	  ⟹ `h · (read ψ) ∈ ⟨read s⟩` for `ψ ∈ K` (the `hann` shape of `isGenerator_of_ann_cutter`).
    34	
    35	* `exists_h_mem_basicOpen_forall_mul_read_mem_span` — **the ann-cutter, seed-shaped**: from
    36	  RD-N (`primeIdealOf z ∉ supp (N z)`) at a point `z` in the chart, a section `h ∈ Γ(V)` with
    37	  `z ∈ D(h)` and `h · (read ψ) ∈ ⟨read s⟩` for all `ψ ∈ K` — exactly the seed's `h z` +
    38	  `mem_basicOpen` + `hann` data, packaged for the concrete `seedUniv'` assembly.
    39	
    40	The support-avoidance premise `primeIdealOf z ∉ supp (N z)` is **RD-N proper**; discharging it
    41	(the achiever fibre-generation + the landed chart flat, via the `κ(p)→𝒪_z` transport) is the
    42	remaining geometric content (I-0302 §residual 2b/2c).  This file is certificate-free,
    43	`IsGenerator`-free, and consumes only the landed ann-cutter engine + `chartReadMap`.
    44	-/
    45	
    46	set_option autoImplicit false
    47	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    48	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    49	
    50	universe u v
    51	
    52	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    53	open scoped TensorProduct
    54	
    55	/-! ## The reusable finiteness core -/
    56	
    57	/-- **The `S`-span of the range of an `R`-linear map out of a finite `R`-module is `S`-finite.**
    58	For an `R`-algebra `S`, a finite `R`-module `M`, and a scalar-tower `S`-module `N`, the
    59	`S`-submodule `Submodule.span S (Set.range f)` generated by the image of `f : M →ₗ[R] N` is a
    60	finite `S`-module: a finite `R`-generating set `T` of `M` yields the finite `S`-generating set
    61	`f '' T` (every `f m` is an `R`-combination of the `f tᵢ`, hence an `S`-combination).  Pure
    62	algebra; the finiteness route for the concrete colength `N z`. -/
    63	theorem Module.Finite.span_range_of_finite_isScalarTower
    64	    {R S M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    65	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    66	    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    67	    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    68	    Module.Finite S (Submodule.span S (Set.range f)) := by
    69	  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := (Module.Finite.fg_top (R := R) (M := M))
    70	  have hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = Submodule.span S (f '' T) := by
    71	    apply le_antisymm
    72	    · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    73	      rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    74	      have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span R (T : Set M) := by rw [hT]; trivial
    75	      have hfm : f m ∈ Submodule.span R (f '' T) := by
    76	        rw [← Submodule.map_span]
    77	        exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hm
    78	      exact (Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars R S (f '' T)) hfm
    79	    · exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_subset_range f T)
    80	  rw [hspan]
    81	  exact Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr (Submodule.fg_span (T.finite_toSet.image f))
    82	
    83	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    84	
    85	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    86	
    87	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    88	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    89	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
    90	
    91	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
    92	
    93	/-! ## The concrete chart-level colength `N z` -/
    94	
    95	/-- **The concrete chart-level colength `N z`** (I-0302 §residual 2a): the `Γ(V)`-submodule of
    96	the colength ring `Γ(V) ⧸ ⟨read s⟩` generated by the chart readings `read ψ` of the submodule
    97	`K`, where `V = relPinnedChart C R π b` and `read = relThetaResSide a b le_rfl` (`le_rfl`,
    98	`h z`-free).  A section `h ∈ Γ(V)` annihilates `N z` exactly when `h · (read ψ) ∈ ⟨read s⟩` for
    99	every `ψ ∈ K` — the ann containment the redesigned `hdvd` consumes. -/
   100	noncomputable def chartColengthModule (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   101	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   102	    Submodule Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
   103	      (Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
   104	        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s}) :=
   105	  Submodule.span _ (Set.range
   106	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp
   107	      (chartReadMap K b)))
   108	
   109	/-- The class of a chart reading of a `K`-element lies in `N z`. -/
   110	theorem mk_relThetaResSide_mem_chartColengthModule
   111	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   112	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) {ψ : relThetaSections C R π a} (hψ : ψ ∈ K) :
   113	    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})
   114	        (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ) ∈ chartColengthModule K b s :=
   115	  Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨ψ, hψ⟩, rfl⟩
   116	
   117	/-- **`N z` is a finite `Γ(V)`-module**: from the reusable finiteness core, since `K` is a
   118	finite `R`-module (the chart readings of a finite generating set of `K` span `N z`). -/
   119	theorem chartColengthModule_finite (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   120	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) [Module.Finite R ↥K] :
   121	    Module.Finite Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ↥(chartColengthModule K b s) :=
   122	  Module.Finite.span_range_of_finite_isScalarTower _
   123	
   124	/-! ## The ann→hdvd bridge -/
   125	
   126	/-- **The ann→hdvd bridge** (I-0302 §residual 2a): if `h ∈ Γ(V)` annihilates the colength
   127	`N z = chartColengthModule K b s`, then `h · (read ψ) ∈ ⟨read s⟩` for every `ψ ∈ K` — the ann
   128	containment (`hann` shape) the redesigned `isGenerator_of_ann_cutter` consumes.  The class of
   129	`read ψ` lies in `N z`, so `h • [read ψ] = 0`, i.e. `[h · read ψ] = 0`, i.e.
   130	`h · read ψ ∈ ⟨read s⟩`. -/
   131	theorem forall_mul_read_mem_span_of_forall_smul_eq_zero
   132	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   133	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a)
   134	    {h : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)}
   135	    (hann : ∀ n : ↥(chartColengthModule K b s), h • n = 0) :
   136	    ∀ ⦃ψ : relThetaSections C R π a⦄, ψ ∈ K →
   137	      h * relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ
   138	        ∈ Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s} := by
   139	  intro ψ hψ
   140	  set I := Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s} with hI
   141	  have hmem := mk_relThetaResSide_mem_chartColengthModule K b s hψ
   142	  have hz := hann ⟨_, hmem⟩
   143	  have hz' : h • Ideal.Quotient.mk I (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ) = 0 := by
   144	    have h2 := congrArg (Subtype.val) hz
   145	    rw [SetLike.val_smul, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at h2
   146	    exact h2
   147	  rw [show h • Ideal.Quotient.mk I (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ)
   148	        = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (h * relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ) by
   149	      rw [Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← map_mul]] at hz'
   150	  exact (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem).mp hz'
   151	
   152	/-! ## The ann-cutter, seed-shaped (RD-N ⟹ the cutter `h z`) -/
   153	
   154	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   155	-- the ann-cutter application over the heavy `relCurve` chart section ring re-synthesizes the
   156	-- finite-module / support instances past the default synthesis budget
   157	/-- **The ann-based fibre-cutter, seed-shaped** (I-0302 §residual 2a→ann-cutter): from **RD-N
   158	proper** — the support-avoidance `primeIdealOf z ∉ Module.support Γ(V) (N z)` for the concrete
   159	colength `N z = chartColengthModule K b s` at a point `z` in the chart `V = relPinnedChart C R π b`
   160	— there is a section `h ∈ Γ(V)` with `z ∈ D(h)` and `h · (read ψ) ∈ ⟨read s⟩` for every `ψ ∈ K`.
   161	
   162	This packages the landed ann-cutter engine `IsAffineOpen.exists_mem_basicOpen_forall_smul_eq_zero`
   163	with the ann→hdvd bridge: the engine gives `h` annihilating `N z` with `z ∈ D(h)`, and the bridge
   164	turns `h · N z = 0` into the seed's `hann` containment.  Exactly the seed's `h z` +
   165	`mem_basicOpen` + `hann` data for the concrete `seedUniv'`; the RD-N premise is the honest
   166	remaining wall (I-0302 §residual 2b/2c). -/
   167	theorem exists_h_mem_basicOpen_forall_mul_read_mem_span
   168	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   169	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) [Module.Finite R ↥K]
   170	    {z : relCurve C R} (hz : z ∈ relPinnedChart C R π b)
   171	    (hsupp : (isAffineOpen_relPinnedChart C R π b).primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩ ∉
   172	      Module.support Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ↥(chartColengthModule K b s)) :
   173	    ∃ h : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b),
   174	      z ∈ (relCurve C R).basicOpen h ∧
   175	      ∀ ⦃ψ : relThetaSections C R π a⦄, ψ ∈ K →
   176	        h * relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ
   177	          ∈ Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s} := by
   178	  haveI := chartColengthModule_finite K b s
   179	  obtain ⟨h, hmem, hann⟩ :=
   180	    (isAffineOpen_relPinnedChart C R π b).exists_mem_basicOpen_forall_smul_eq_zero
"}

    65	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    66	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    67	variable (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    68	variable (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)

    94	theorem flat_chart_colength_divUniversalSeedK (b : Bool)

This is the “dense closed points \(\Rightarrow \) hom-extensionality” connective that Mathlib does not package directly: it supplies only the single-dominant-morphism extensionality \(\mathtt{ext\_ of\_ isDominant}\) (a dominant morphism into a separated target is an epimorphism for the purpose of right-cancellation). We assemble the per-closed-point hypotheses into one such dominant probe. Form the coproduct \(P := \coprod _{x \in \mathrm{closedPoints}\, W} \operatorname{Spec}\kappa (x)\) and the morphism \(\mathrm{probe} \colon P \to W\) defined by \(\mathtt{Sigma.desc}\) of the residue-field points \(W.\mathtt{fromSpecResidueField}\, x\). Its topological range contains every closed point of \(W\): the inclusion \(\iota _x \colon \operatorname{Spec}\kappa (x) \to P\) composes with \(\mathrm{probe}\) to \(W.\mathtt{fromSpecResidueField}\, x\) (the defining property of \(\mathtt{Sigma.desc}\)), and the range of \(W.\mathtt{fromSpecResidueField}\, x\) is the singleton \(\{ x\} \) (\(\mathtt{Scheme.range\_ fromSpecResidueField}\)). Because \(W\) is a Jacobson space, the closed points are dense (\(\mathtt{closure\_ closedPoints}\), i.e. \(\overline{\mathrm{closedPoints}\, W} = W\)), so the range of \(\mathrm{probe}\) is dense and \(\mathrm{probe}\) is dominant. Componentwise, \(g_1\) and \(g_2\) agree after \(\mathrm{probe}\): precomposing with each coproduct inclusion \(\iota _x\) reduces (by \(\mathtt{Sigma.\iota \_ desc}\)) to \(W.\mathtt{fromSpecResidueField}\, x \mathbin {\, ;\, }g_1 = W.\mathtt{fromSpecResidueField}\, x \mathbin {\, ;\, }g_2\), which is the hypothesis at the closed point \(x\). By the universal property of the coproduct (\(\mathtt{Sigma.hom\_ ext}\)) this gives \(\mathrm{probe} \mathbin {\, ;\, }g_1 = \mathrm{probe} \mathbin {\, ;\, }g_2\). Since \(\mathrm{probe}\) is dominant and \(Z\) is separated, \(\mathtt{ext\_ of\_ isDominant}\) cancels it on the left to yield \(g_1 = g_2\).

/-- The `κ(x)`-point of `f ⁻¹' {f x}` corresponding to `x`. -/
def Scheme.Hom.asFiberHom (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) : Spec (X.residueField x) ⟶ f.fiber (f x) :=
  pullback.lift (X.fromSpecResidueField x) (Spec.map (f.residueFieldMap _)) (by simp)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma Scheme.Hom.asFiberHom_fiberι (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    f.asFiberHom x ≫ f.fiberι _ = X.fromSpecResidueField x := pullback.lift_fst ..

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma Scheme.Hom.asFiberHom_fiberToSpecResidueField (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    f.asFiberHom x ≫ f.fiberToSpecResidueField _ = Spec.map (f.residueFieldMap _) :=
  pullback.lift_snd ..

@[simp]
lemma Scheme.Hom.asFiberHom_apply (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) (y) :
    f.asFiberHom x y = f.asFiber x :=
  (f.fiberι _).isEmbedding.injective (by simp [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply])

@[simp]
lemma Scheme.Hom.range_asFiberHom (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    Set.range (f.asFiberHom x) = {f.asFiber x} := by aesop

instance (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) : IsPreimmersion (f.asFiberHom x) :=
  have : IsPreimmersion (f.asFiberHom x ≫ f.fiberι _) := f.asFiberHom_fiberι x ▸ inferInstance
  .of_comp _ (f.fiberι _)
